fractional-ownership-vs-timeshare.title: Fractional Ownership vs Timeshare: What You Actually Own
fractional-ownership-vs-timeshare.subtitle: Two products with similar surface appeal and fundamentally different fundamentals. The deeded-asset / right-to-use distinction is the whole game.

fractional-ownership-vs-second-home.metaDescription: The whole house costs eight times as much and most owners use it six weeks. Compared on purchase price, running costs and what happens when you sell.

cop-vs-going-direct.title: Buying Through an Agent vs Going Direct to the Operator
